objective: expose the persistent typed planner and exact event-driven invalidation path to one bounded natural threat sequence from a reproducible real Freedoom MAP01 state

fixture.authority: setup state only; grants no runtime input
fixture.runtime_gate: session receipt must show successful hash, ViZDoom, IWAD, MAP01 and skill validation before load; measured control starts after load

environment.app_server: Codex Desktop 0.153.4 Windows via WSL stdio

guard.authority: cancel matching planner turn and current cover; discard dependent action and next_cover; grant no input

stop_rule: retain the first run at 6 decisions, death, model terminal state, runtime failure or independent episode end; do not retry this allocation
threat_exposure_rule: the fixture is prior setup evidence; classify this allocation as threat-exposed only if its retained exact initial/source/temporal frame is independently inspected and visibly contains an enemy
natural_invalidation_acceptance: guard outcome comes from an exact advancing runtime observation with no injection
the matching planner turn receives at most one interrupt and its result is ineligible for action admission
the active cover reaches a terminal with verified empty key/button release
the invalidated model action and its next_cover admit zero input and supply no following cover
a later fresh decision can complete on the same persistent app-server thread
normal_path_acceptance: every started planner turn reaches one matching terminal; every admitted cover and plan reaches verified terminal release; usage missingness remains explicit
no_invalidation_disposition: retain as fixed-threat but natural-invalidation unexposed and do not retry this ID
failure_disposition: retain the exact failure and diagnose before any differently versioned run
comparison_limit: single loaded real-MAP01 state, sequential allocation and nondeterministic model output; report mechanics and descriptive outcomes only
scope: one bounded Linux/X11 natural-invalidation allocation from a fixed real threat state; no causal survival, reliability, generality, human-speed, Product Hunt completion or MAP01-clear claim
